title: GTA 6 Is OUT: $80, 212 GB and NO Disc 😳
description:
GTA 6 is finally out — it unlocked at YOUR midnight, and the "physical" copy has no disc. 📦

Grand Theft Auto VI launched on 19 November 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, rolling out at midnight local time region by region (New Zealand first). Standard Edition: $79.99, Ultimate Edition: $99.99 (India: ₹5,999 / ₹7,499 on PlayStation Store). You need up to 212 GB of free space — about 45 DVDs. The catch: the boxed copy is a download code, no disc inside, and there's no PC release date yet.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 61/100 → SPEC, if you've got the console and the space. (Rivals like Battlefield 6 and Ghost of Yōtei launched at $69.99.)

Spec or wreck? Tell us below 👇
